indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX error_log_acknowledged_retention_idx ON public.error_log USING btree (last_seen_at) WHERE (acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX error_log_unread_last_seen_idx ON public.error_log USING btree (last_seen_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (acknowledged_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX comision_unica_activa_idx ON public.comision USING btree (activa) WHERE (activa IS TRUE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entrega_assignment_alumno_unique_idx ON public.entrega USING btree (assignment_id, alumno_id) WHERE (alumno_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entrega_assignment_grupo_unique_idx ON public.entrega USING btree (assignment_id, grupo_id) WHERE (grupo_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entrega_repo_name_unique_idx ON public.entrega USING btree (lower((repo_name)::text)) WHERE (repo_name IS NOT NULL)
